synthesizedFacts.fact: Hyperpigmentation is a common condition in individuals with darker skin tones, often caused by increased melanin production due to skin trauma, inflammation, or hormonal changes.
Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and melasma are two prevalent types of hyperpigmentation in darker skin tones, with melasma often linked to hormonal changes.
Natural remedies such as aloe vera, apple cider vinegar, and green tea extract are suggested for treating hyperpigmentation, though their efficacy may vary.
Topical treatments like hydroquinone, retinoids, and vitamin C are commonly recommended for hyperpigmentation, but should be used cautiously in darker skin tones to avoid further pigmentation issues.
